note: Expected drops per 100 deployment points an enemy fleet loses, then times battle difficulty (capped at 3x, scaled by difficulty_scaling: 1 = full, 0 = ignored) and the fleet's loot multipliers. A linear drop scales 1:1; a diminishing one runs at full rate up to 3000 DP in one battle and grows with the square root of DP past it. Star Charts fleets drop the full rate; fleets outside charts drop 0.5x at level 1 rising to 1x at the game's level cap. crafting_item is every crafting item together, picked from crafting_drops.csv; at this rate a tier 15 chart's fleets and boss drop about 50
